name: Ruou can
summary: The provincial introduction names rượu cần in the mountains, beside rượu đót. ZaloPay describes the Hre jar in Ba Tơ: forest-leaf yeast, upland sticky rice, and a clay jar. No strength and no price were printed.
culture: ZaloPay says Hre communities in Ba Tơ serve the jar at gatherings. The provincial introduction names rượu cần and rượu đót and does not describe a feast.
taste: ZaloPay calls the jar sweetly strong. It prints no alcohol figure.
howToEat: ZaloPay: yeast from forest leaves, upland sticky rice, fermented in a clay jar, drunk from the jar when a guest is received.
The provincial introduction prints no method.
No price was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Ba Tơ, in ZaloPay. The provincial introduction says the mountains and does not name a village.
seoTitle: Ruou can — the jar in Ba To
seoDescription: Rượu cần in the mountains. ZaloPay describes the Hre jar in Ba Tơ. No price was printed. Check on arrival.
